tasks.gr12-prescribed-texts-orientation-t1: Topic: Grade 12 English HL prescribed-text orientation. Cover prescribed drama, novel and poetry study, key literary terminology, quotation support, contextual questioning and the structure of Papers 1, 2 and 3. Ask learners to identify paper demands, choose strong quotation evidence, distinguish theme from plot, interpret common literature terminology and explain how to prepare a quotation bank for NSC study.
tasks.gr12-literary-essay-contextual-skills-t1: Topic: Grade 12 English HL literary essay and contextual-response skills. Cover essay planning, thesis statements, paragraph development, contextual questions, extract-based analysis and linking details to whole-text meaning. Ask learners to choose stronger thesis statements, identify effective evidence, distinguish contextual from essay responses and improve analytical paragraphs using formal literary terminology.
tasks.gr12-paper3-essay-writing-t1: Topic: Grade 12 English HL Paper 3 essay writing. Cover narrative, descriptive, reflective, discursive and argumentative essays, planning, introductions, paragraph unity, and the full process-writing cycle. Ask learners to match prompts to essay types, choose strong thesis or reflection lines, identify features of each genre and improve structure, coherence and style in essay openings and body paragraphs.
tasks.gr12-paper1-language-practice-t1: Topic: Grade 12 English HL Paper 1 language practice. Cover comprehension strategies, summary rules, visual literacy, editing, inference, diction, tone and oral-preparation habits. Ask learners to identify main ideas, choose strong inferences, avoid summary penalties, interpret advertisements or cartoons and correct language errors in short edited passages.
